# Synthetic fixture (OBS15-01): one service that ships several overlapping tools.
flask==3.0.3
gunicorn==22.0.0
ddtrace==2.9.2
newrelic==9.11.0
opentelemetry-api==1.25.0
sentry-sdk[flask]==2.5.1
rollbar==1.0.0
prometheus-client==0.20.0
datadog==0.49.1

// Synthetic fixture (OBS15-01): Go service with two tracers.
module example.com/billing

go 1.22

require (
	github.com/go-chi/chi/v5 v5.0.12
	gopkg.in/DataDog/dd-trace-go.v1 v1.64.1
	go.opentelemetry.io/otel v1.27.0
	go.opentelemetry.io/otel/sdk v1.27.0
	go.opentelemetry.io/contrib/instrumentation/net/http/otelhttp v0.52.0
	github.com/newrelic/go-agent/v3 v3.33.0 // indirect
)

# Synthetic fixture (OBS15-01): telemetry agent sidecars in one pod.
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: checkout
  namespace: shop
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: example.com/checkout:1.4.2
        - name: datadog-agent
          image: gcr.io/datadoghq/agent:7.54.0
          env:
            - name: DD_API_KEY
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef: {name: datadog, key: api-key}
        - name: otel-collector
          image: otel/opentelemetry-collector-contrib:0.102.0
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: catalog
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      initContainers:
        - name: log-router
          image: public.ecr.aws/aws-observability/aws-for-fluent-bit:2.32.2
          restartPolicy: Always
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: example.com/catalog:2.0.0
        - name: fluentd
          image: fluent/fluentd:v1.16-1
